description: Ministry of Education - Order made under Section 27(1) Department of Information Technology - University of the visual and performing Arts, Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette notification contains an order made under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, specifically amending the schedule to establish a new department. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and legal amendments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
